limitations: The three sources were authored for this example; none is claimed as a migrated published puzzle or tutorial example.
The environment is the whole raw CLVM tree, not a one-argument list; atom bytes are not interpreted as integers or truth values.
The host oracle caps right-tail recursion at depth 128 and reports an error beyond that bound; the compiled policy adds no depth guard.
Named and generated cases connect native execution to independently compiled Chialisp, Rust off/on and Rue off/on only for those executions.

      value
    )
  )
  (rightmost ENV)
)
puzzles.security_scope: Original recursion teaching function, not a coin puzzle, authorization policy, last-list-element helper or published canonical port. Every finite atom/pair tree has an intended result: follow pair tails until an atom and preserve all its bytes. A proper list returns nil. Finite native/VM comparisons do not establish general termination, compiler preservation or equal resource behavior; native comparisons are limited to a right-tail depth of 128.
